Use case: identity-preserve. FOUR whole-body key drawings in a 2x2 transparent sprite sheet, continuation of Utsu's WEIGHTED acrobatic dual-sword attack.
Image1 approved idle is AUTHORITATIVE identity, adult anatomy/limb length and weapon length. Image2 corrected first/second-hit sheet is reference for forceful pelvic turns and footwork. Keep the exact lean adult male, same small adult head relative to long torso/thighs/shins, same navy tattered cape, ivory split tunic, dark trousers, brown straps, brass star brooch and asymmetric silver armor. Same two physical straight steel swords with brass guards, one sword firmly gripped in each of exactly two hands. No extra limbs. Same fine anime painted shading as references.
Important: torso/head orientation CHANGES during the turn; no four repeating chest-front bodies with only hands moved. Body must look as large and adult as idle; mentally unfolded body7heads. Long thighs and shins remain long even when bent. Do not shrink the pelvis/chest or enlarge the head. Fixed camera, target SCREEN RIGHT, fullbody all poses.
TOP LEFT THIRD WINDUP / STEP-THROUGH: continue image2 bottomright ascending return by rotating behind the planted RIGHT/front foot. BACK THREE-QUARTER view with face looking right over shoulder. Rear/left foot is stepping across and planting under rotating pelvis, both feet near ground, knees only moderately bent. Hips visibly turn ahead of ribcage, shoulders coil last. Active sword carried around at WAIST height toward LEFT, opposing sword higher over rear shoulder pointing up-left. Athletic tall adult silhouette, braced support leg and fully visible long trailing leg.
TOP RIGHT THIRD CONTACT / TORQUE RELEASE: pelvis and ribcage have unwound into FRONT THREE-QUARTER view, same long legs. Strongly planted lead foot supports full body weight, heel/pivot turns, rear leg extends diagonally back as counterweight. Active elbow stays slightly bent as whole shoulder travels across, sword sweeps to SCREEN RIGHT horizontally chest height. Opposite sword reaches low-left behind trailing hip. Belt/hips rotate more than60degrees from previous cel and torso leans into cut15degrees. A committed whole-body rotational CUT, not a hand thrust or kicking dance.
BOTTOM LEFT FOURTH TAKEOFF / RECOIL LOAD: carry third cut's angular momentum into a visible spring: supporting boot ball pushes hard DOWN against ground, long supporting leg almost extends, opposite knee drives upward. Pelvis rotates upward before shoulders. Show a BACK/SIDE view with both sword grips close to shoulders, one blade above/behind head pointing left, one across near right hip pointing right. Hips/chest not front-on. Cape and coat lag left/down behind mass accelerating up-right. Not a miniature crouch. Clear elongated upper body and unshortened lower leg.
BOTTOM RIGHT FOURTH CONTACT / AIRBORNE BODY-DRIVEN SCISSOR: both boots offground, body travels RIGHT. Three-quarter front SIDE view, pelvis forcefully turns over leading hip while shoulders follow. Long lead leg bent at knee, trailing leg extends down-left as counterweight. Torso leans diagonally forward, head aligned with spine, hips visibly behind shoulder. Active sword sweeps diagonally from high-left to low-right across opponent chest, hand driven by turning shoulder with bent elbow, blade fully extended toward down-right. Opposite sword stays behind left shoulder, blade points left. Entire body is an athletic airborne twist, preparing forward somersault after contact.
Both COMPLETE swords, boots, cape and head in every cell. At least8% clear outer margins and generous transparent gutters, no touching/overlap, no sword tips on image border. Consistent full-size adult body dimensions in all four, do not fit bent legs by changing body size. True transparent alpha, no floor/shadow, no text/labels/grids, no scene, slash streak, glow, sparks, blur or colored edge.
CORRECTION: Produce a PORTRAIT / tall 1536x2048-style composition, all FOUR whole-body figures must have a 15% transparent clearance border inside each cell. The prior sheet had swords from two DIFFERENT characters touching/overlapping at the center. Absolutely separate all four whole-body alpha components, each is isolated with EMPTY transparent gutters between ALL blades. Keep every long adult leg and complete sword, scale whole characters down to leave room, never shorten limbs. TOP LEFT sword at waist must point left as specified; it must NOT point into the top-right character. No glow or fog background.

Production FULL-BODY CEL ANIMATION, true transparent alpha. A PORTRAIT 1536x2048-shaped 2x2 sheet with FOUR full-body adult Utsu key drawings; large EMPTY gutters. Reference1 is the approved adult Utsu identity/actual long-legged proportions/weapon design. Reference2 is corrected ground attack style; continue its pelvic and shoulder turn, but these are missing IN-BETWEEN transfer-of-weight cels, not repeat poses.
Exactly same lean adult male with messy brown hair, focused gray eyes, navy torn cape/ivory split tunic/dark shirt and trousers, brown straps and belt/brass star brooch, asymmetric silver armor and armored boots. SAME adult head, torso and leg length as idle; use 7 head unfolded body. Do NOT make the legs short or head big. TWO straight physical steel swords with brass guards, one in each of two hands, entire swords/feet inside each cell, NO extra limbs.
Fixed right-facing gamecamera. Each pose transmits force from planted boot through hip belt rotation then shoulder before the hand. CLEAR CHANGING torso/hip orientations and weight shifts, blade cuts an arc, no fencing thrust.
TOPLEFT DRIVE1: BETWEEN loaded back-three-quarter coil and first forward cut. Rear foot ball drives DOWN and rear knee has started extending, front boot plants to right, hips have already pivoted halfway to front view while chest/shoulders still lag toward back/side view. One shoulder swept forward, other back. Active sword still drawn behind head toward LEFT with elbow bent; hands have NOT overtaken rotating chest. Pelvis advances ahead of the shoulder. Front knee moderate bend, full-length shins. Cape flares left. Show powerful connected long adult body, clear rotation preceding blade.
TOPRIGHT DRIVE2: BETWEEN low follow-through and ascending second cut. Rear/trailing boot STEPS IN and pushes ground, front heel turns, pelvis has wound toward BACK view while chest is still FRONT/SIDE. Second sword raised from low-left across waist beginning ascent, active hand below chest; elbow tucked, first sword finishes low-right. Torso lifted, spine diagonal forward and knees moderately bent. The rising waist and opposing shoulder visibly drive the cut. Not a mini crouch.
BOTTOMLEFT DRIVE3: BETWEEN back-facing loaded turn and third sweeping contact. Show strict SIDE profile, hip belt rotated toward right opponent but shoulders still nearly back view and active elbow still drawn behind ribs. Both boots planted wide; rear heel lifts and front supporting leg turns at ankle/knee. Active sword passes from rear-left through waist level as body unwinds toward RIGHT, other sword counters behind/above. Solid visible leg loading and long adult torso, no kick, no airborne.
BOTTOMRIGHT OPEN5: BETWEEN tucked airborne forward somersault and descending fifth contact. Whole body diagonal head toward RIGHT, hips above/behind shoulders as turn unfolds; rear long leg stretches LEFT and front long leg reaches DOWNRIGHT to plant next instant, both boots still just airborne. Chest untucks and shoulder turns DOWNRIGHT. Active sword raised above/behind shoulder toward upper-left, with elbow bent READY to bring weight down through the cut; opposite sword trails left at hip height. Adult body and head NOT shrunk by crouch. Whole forceful body silhouette clearly follows gravity.
Keep each character centered WELL INSIDE its own cell at common anatomical scale. Each cell includes TWO whole swords and all hair/cape/boots, HUGE 15% empty outer border and gutter; blades of separate figures must never touch or overlap. Make figures smaller overall if needed for clearance. Matching clean painted anime sprite linework, neutral alpha edges, true transparent background. No background/floor/shadow, aura, motion blur, slash streaks, labels, text, panel lines or glow.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference1 is the approved Utsu battle sprite. Reference2 is an attack pose reference. Draw TWO full-body key cels SIDE BY SIDE, only TWO (one row of two, NEVER a 2x2 sheet), REAL transparent alpha. Full-size adult Utsu with exactly the same long-legged adult proportions and head-to-body ratio as reference1. The previous four-per-sheet approach made him short/squat: rectify this. SAME slim tall adult male, seven head lengths from crown to sole when unfolded. Both straight long steel swords, entire boots, cape and head comfortably within EACH panel. Preserve his actual chest length and especially LONG THIGHS AND SHINS. Head should be small in relation to body, never a big-headed short-legged sprite. Use the tall space of image, do NOT compress anatomy. Same face/tousled brown hair/gray focused eyes, navy ragged short cape, ivory split tunic, dark trousers/shirt, brown crossing straps/belt and brass star brooch, asymmetrical silver armor and armored boots. Exactly two arms/hands/legs, TWO physical steel straight swords with brass guards, one gripped in each hand. Same fine painted anime rendering. Fixed side-game camera, opponent SCREEN RIGHT. No extra characters.
Action must show a hard cut driven from rear boot through pelvis then ribcage and shoulders, not a hand poke. Sternum, hip buckle, knees and foot pivots change orientation. Physical mass over planted supporting foot. No deep seated squat; knees flex enough to carry weight but head remains at80-95% of approved idle height. Blade CUTS through a curved path and elbow stays slightly bent, not an arm-extended fencing thrust.
Give TWO entire isolated alpha silhouettes a wide EMPTY transparent gutter, at least10% transparent margin all around each; swords from different figures never touch or overlap. No sword tip/boot/cape touching canvas edges. No text, grids, arrows, floor, ground shadows, glow, aura, blur, speed lines, slash streak or colored fringe.
LEFT COIL: back-three-quarter, loaded rear foot, front boot stepping toward right and beginning to plant. Pelvis/chest wound away from opponent, active sword drawn behind shoulder pointing LEFT, opposite sword down-left. Tall braced spine, full long legs. Face looks right over shoulder.
RIGHT FIRST CONTACT: commit to right front leg with rear heel lifting and rear leg driving long. Pelvis rotates toward right and chest opens into SIDE/FRONT view60degrees from left cel, torso leaning20degrees into cut. Active hand crosses forward at chest height, elbow bent, sword blade is mid DIAGONAL down-right slash across enemy chest, not thrust. Other sword counterbalances low LEFT. Strong hip/shoulder torsion and complete adult body.
